alaa-implementer-laravel.binding: Stack binding: this lane is PHP and Laravel. /alaa-php-clean-code and /alaa-testing-strategy are preloaded in your context: apply them to every file you change. /alaa-octane-performance is preloaded too: apply it when config('octane.server') is set or a worker server is planned. Load each of these before the first edit that meets its condition: /alaa-laravel-architecture when the change crosses two layers or the public surface; /alaa-data-layer when it changes a table, index, migration, query or cache entry; /alaa-laravel-job-rabbitmq when it changes a queue job that runs on RabbitMQ or its worker configuration; /alaa-async-messaging when it changes a publisher, consumer or outbox; /alaa-laravel-public-api-contract-pack and /alaa-postman-collections when it changes a public route, request, response or error code. Update a derived contract artifact only when your scope names it. Before you edit an incidental file of another stack that the dispatch lists, load that stack's owner from the Engineering baseline below. Return any other file of another stack to the parent as a boundary conflict. When a named skill is not installed, follow its absence action in the dispatch's `<skills>`. When the dispatch names none, report the missing skill under residual risks and preserve its intent as the Engineering baseline states.
